name: 37-pgss-statement-families
sql: select case when query ilike '%rebuild_style_group%' or query ilike '%refresh_style_group_counts%' then 'rebuild_style_groups' when query ilike '%refresh_style_guide_matviews%' then 'refresh_style_guide_matviews' when query ilike '%clear_style_group%' then 'clear_style_group' when query ilike '%claim_sg_search_embedding%' or query ilike '%search_dam_documents%' then 'search_sync_embed' when query ilike '%vacuum%' or query ilike 'ANALYZE%' then 'vacuum_analyze' else 'other' end as family, count(*) as entries, sum(calls) as calls, sum(wal_bytes) as wal_bytes, sum(wal_records) as wal_records, sum(wal_fpi) as wal_fpi from extensions.pg_stat_statements group by 1 order by sum(wal_bytes)::numeric desc nulls last
